name: قياسي
description: انطلق في مهمة للقضاء على البرج!
multiplayer_description: انطلق في مهمة للقضاء على البرج... مع الأصدقاء!

name: يومي
description:
تحدٍ جديد متاح مرة كل يوم.

نافس اللاعبين الآخرين على أعلى نتيجة!
multiplayer_description:
تحدٍ جديد متاح مرة كل يوم.

نافس المجموعات الأخرى على أعلى نتيجة!
unlock_info: العب جولة واحدة بكل الشخصيات واهزم الفصل 3 لفتح الجولة اليومية.

name: Dread
description:
The apex difficulty laid forth by the Architect.

Only for those who wish to test their mastery over the Spire.
multiplayer_description:
The apex difficulty laid forth by the Architect.

Only for parties who wish to test their mastery over the Spire.
intro: [gold]Dread[/gold] is the hardest challenge available in Slay the Spire.
rules: At the end of each Act, an [purple]Ascender's Bane[/purple] is added to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Enemies gain additional abilities from the upcoming boss.
unlock_info: Reach [red]Ascension[/red] [blue]10[/blue] on all characters to reveal this Epoch.

dominions.name: زجاج الأيون's Dominion
dominions.description: At the start of your turn, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Wither[/gold] to the top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].

dominions.name: النهم's Dominion
dominions.description: At the end of your turn, take damage based on the turn count.

dominions.name: وحش المعرفة's Dominion
dominions.description: At the start of combat, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]2[/blue] Dominion [red]Banes[/red].

dominions.name: أم لاغافولين's Dominion
dominions.description: At the end of your first turn, lose [red]1[/red] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold].

dominions.name: الملكة's Dominion
dominions.description: At the start of turn 2, gain [red]3[/red] [gold]Weak[/gold], [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Frail[/gold].

dominions.name: سمكة طيفية's Dominion
dominions.description: At the start of each combat, shuffle a [gold]Beckon[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].

dominions.name: عملاق الشلال's Dominion
dominions.description: Enemies explode on death, dealing damage.

rotating_streak.name: Rotating Streak
rotating_streak.description:
In a [gold]Rotating Streak[/gold], each win advances you one character to the right.
Wins are tracked in a separate streak, and no longer count towards individual characters'.

name: Blitz
description: Faster and condensed runs for those who seek a shorter journey.
multiplayer_description: Faster and condensed runs for groups who seek a shorter journey.
intro: Welcome to [green]Blitz[/green] mode! These quick runs have a separate Ascension difficulty shared across all characters and major changes that focus more on deckbuilding.
rules: Receive cards at the start of each run.
unlock_info: Play a single Ascension run to unlock Blitz.

neow.name: Blitz
neow.description: Choose [blue]3[/blue] cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].

merchant_entries.name: Card Packs
merchant_entries.description: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]2[/blue] packs of cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].

merchant_entries.name: Cursed Card Rewards
merchant_entries.description:
Receive [red]1[/red] random [red]Curse[/red].
Receive [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Common[/gold], [gold]Uncommon[/gold] and [gold]Rare[/gold] card reward.

merchant_entries.name: Cursed Heal
merchant_entries.description:
Receive [red]1[/red] random [red]Curse[/red].
Raise your Max HP by [blue]6[/blue] and heal all of your HP.

merchant_entries.name: Potions
merchant_entries.description: Gain [blue]1[/blue] potion slot and procure [blue]2[/blue] random potions.

merchant_entries.name: Cursed Choices
merchant_entries.description:
Receive [red]1[/red] random [red]Curse[/red].
The Merchant allows you to purchase two more wares.

merchant_entries.name: Cursed Upgraded Rare Card Reward
merchant_entries.description:
Receive [red]1[/red] random [red]Curse[/red].
Receive [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Upgraded[/gold] rare card reward.
